label: Focus-state contradiction: the iteration prompt targets Q2, but canonical state resolved Q2 at iteration 3 (registry resolvedAtIteration 3, strategy section 3 checked); the Q2 focus derives from a stale carried-forward row (strategy 11A) and a stale NEXT FOCUS (strategy 11). The canonical open set is Q3/Q4/Q5; iteration 4 proceeded on Q3 per the no-operator contradiction protocol.

Rebuild machinery for generated artifacts: trigger index is regenerated by runtime/cli/retrieval/generate-trigger-index.mjs (with continuity/migrate-trigger-phrase-residual.ts as the phrase-migration CLI); runtime mirrors by runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs plus sync-gate1-pointers.cjs and sync-hook-registrations.cjs, with per-runtime syncs (hermes/sync-skills-hermes.cjs, codex/sync-agents.cjs, pi/sync-agents-pi.cjs); compiled routes by .skilled/bin/compiled-route-sync.cjs over the hub registry JSONs via the lib/compiled-routing compilers, with compiled-route-guard/-manifest/-status/-admission forming the toolchain.

Graph metadata is the graph-metadata.json artifact family: required phase-parent metadata (PHASE_PARENT_REQUIRED_FILES in spec-doc-health.ts) and mandatory spec metadata (gate-3-classifier.ts), plus the sk-code skill-graph at .skilled/skills/sk-code/graph-metadata.json consumed by the advisor shared payload; refresh/write via runtime/lib/graph/graph-metadata-parser.ts (refreshGraphMetadataForSpecFolder, writeGraphMetadataFile) with runtime/cli/graph/migrate-generated-json.ts as the migration CLI and GENERATED_METADATA_DRIFT as the drift rule.

Guard layer: run-all-drift-guards.sh runs the four sk-code drift guards in sequence (alignment-drift verify_alignment_drift.py --check-router; stack-folders verify_stack_folders.py; router-sync verify-router-sync.cjs --checks 1a,1b,2,3,4; doc-claims verify-doc-claims.cjs), treats warnings as non-blocking and exits 1 on any FAIL; the compiled side of router-sync checks 3 and 4 is covered warn-only by .github/workflows/routing-registry-drift.yml; mirror integrity has .skilled/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs; guards resolve paths from the script location, so a folder rename re-points them automatically.

Residual for Q3: the advisor DB rebuild/reindex command was not located in .skilled (the advisor is the daemon-backed skill-advisor.cjs CLI and its shared payload references the sk-code skill-graph); the trigger-index drift guard was not isolated (its builder and the phrase-migration CLI were found). Fold both into the Q4 plan.

Generated artifacts must be rebuilt by their sync/generate scripts, not hand-edited: compiled routes via compiled-route-sync.cjs, trigger index via generate-trigger-index.mjs, mirrors via sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs, graph metadata via the graph-metadata refresh/write path; guards are path-derived and re-point automatically, but literal pins (parent-skill-check 5l SK_CODE_NATIVE_SURFACE, doctor path literals, surface-count snapshots and packet tests) must move in the same change.
